title: Quit a government job in 1982 alongside three brothers to start a
statement: Quit a government job in 1982 alongside three brothers to start a quail- and chicken-breeding business in Sichuan.

title: Pivoted the family business into animal feed in 1992
statement: Pivoted the family business into animal feed in 1992, founding Hope Group (later New Hope Group).
outcome: New Hope Group grew into China's largest animal-feed producer by 2010, per Wikipedia, and Liu was named one of Fortune's 15 business people who changed China in 2012.

title: Ceded the chairmanship of listed subsidiary New Hope Liuhe to his
statement: Ceded the chairmanship of listed subsidiary New Hope Liuhe to his daughter Liu Chang in 2013.
outcome: Liu Chang became chairman of New Hope Liuhe in 2013, marking a generational leadership transition at the listed subsidiary.
